notes: The eval score decouples from raw accuracy because near-miss predictions (e.g. L1 vs L2) carry only a mild overshoot penalty; large undershoots (L4 predicted as L1) are what drag the score down.

Baseline confusion shows the rule-based router (a) overpredicts L2 for trivial L1 tasks and (b) undershoots on L3/L4 architectural work — those are the two failure modes the Arbor Squad should target.
